metadata.title: [CHORE]: Publish Last Version of Context Forge Into PyPi Registry
metadata.author: SirSerch

description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

We detected that the current version in the PyPi registry is not updated with the lastest version of MCP Context Forge, this is an issue, because for us is very difficult to update the system without the package published in PyPi. Should be great if everytime that a new version is released is automatically pushed into the pypi registry.

---

### 🧱 Area Affected

Choose the general area(s) that this chore affects:

- [X] GitHub Actions / CI Pipelines

---

### ⚙️ Context / Rationale

The current versions of the Context Forge are not syncronized with the version in the PyPi Registry.

---

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] When a new version is released is automatically published on PyPi
---

### 🧩 Additional Context

Currently the last version that we have published is the 1.0.0rc1. And we dont have the GA 1.0.0 published yet.
